mapper.select: SELECT ct.class_id, ct.class_name, ct.class_begin, ct.class_duration AS class_time, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(e2.employee_name ORDER BY e2.employee_id) FROM class_coach cc2 JOIN employee e2 ON e2.employee_id = cc2.coach_id WHERE cc2.class_id = ct.class_id) AS coach, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cc2.coach_id ORDER BY cc2.coach_id) FROM class_coach cc2 WHERE cc2.class_id = ct.class_id) AS coachIds, e.employee_id AS coachId, ct.class_level AS classLevel, ct.class_duration AS classDuration, ct.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, ct.total_sessions AS total_sessions, ct.class_description AS classDescription, ct.price, COUNT(cr.record_id) AS enrolledCount, CASE WHEN ct.max_capacity IS NULL OR ct.max_capacity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(cr.record_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(ct.max_capacity, 0), 1) END AS capacityUsage, AVG(cr.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(cr.rating) AS rating_count FROM class_table ct LEFT JOIN employee e ON ct.coach_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN class_record cr ON ct.class_id = cr.class_id GROUP BY ct.class_id, ct.class_name, ct.class_begin, ct.class_duration, e.employee_id, ct.class_level, ct.max_capacity, ct.class_description, ct.price ORDER BY ct.class_begin ASC, ct.class_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT ct.class_id, ct.class_name, ct.class_begin, ct.class_duration AS class_time, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(e2.employee_name ORDER BY e2.employee_id) FROM class_coach cc2 JOIN employee e2 ON e2.employee_id = cc2.coach_id WHERE cc2.class_id = ct.class_id) AS coach, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cc2.coach_id ORDER BY cc2.coach_id) FROM class_coach cc2 WHERE cc2.class_id = ct.class_id) AS coachIds, e.employee_id AS coachId, ct.class_level AS classLevel, ct.class_duration AS classDuration, ct.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, ct.total_sessions AS total_sessions, ct.class_description AS classDescription, ct.price FROM class_table ct LEFT JOIN employee e ON ct.coach_id = e.employee_id WHERE ct.class_id = #{classId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ct.class_id) AS courseTotal, COUNT(cr.record_id) AS registrationTotal, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(cr.rating), 0), 1) AS averageRating, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.record_id IS NOT NULL AND cr.rating IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unratedTotal FROM class_table ct LEFT JOIN class_record cr ON ct.class_id = cr.class_id

SELECT ct.class_id AS classId, ct.class_name AS className, e.employee_name AS coach, COUNT(cr.record_id) AS enrolledCount, ct.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, CASE WHEN ct.max_capacity IS NULL OR ct.max_capacity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(cr.record_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(ct.max_capacity, 0), 1) END AS capacityUsage, ROUND(AVG(cr.rating), 1) AS averageRating, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.record_id IS NOT NULL AND cr.rating IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unratedCount FROM class_table ct LEFT JOIN class_record cr ON ct.class_id = cr.class_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON ct.coach_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY ct.class_id, ct.class_name, e.employee_name, ct.max_capacity ORDER BY enrolledCount DESC, capacityUsage DESC, ct.class_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
